ping.description: Check backend heartbeat and current session.

get_capabilities.description: Return truthful per-command backend capability status.

get_server_info.description: Server version, MCP SDK, platform and protocol details.

doctor.description: Inspect runtime, bridge, paths and optional analysis dependencies.

get_session_info.description: Read session UUID, name, sample rate and observed revision scope.

save_session.description: Save current session through Ardour save_state.

create_snapshot.description: Save a named snapshot without replacing an existing snapshot.

list_tracks.description: Paginate routes with stable Ardour IDs and mixer state.

get_track.description: Inspect a route by persistent Ardour ID.

create_track.description: Create an audio/MIDI track or audio bus using Session APIs.

delete_track.description: Delete a non-singleton route; explicit confirm_delete required; not natively undoable.

list_groups.description: Paginate native route groups, stable IDs, properties and member route IDs.

create_group.description: Create an empty route group; returns actual native linkage defaults.

delete_group.description: Remove a nonempty group without deleting its routes; explicit intent; Ardour cannot remove empty groups through this binding.

add_track_to_group.description: Add a route to a group; reject implicit transfer from another group.

remove_track_from_group.description: Remove exact membership without deleting the route; Ardour automatically deletes an ordinary group when its last member leaves.

set_group_properties.description: Set explicit group linkage booleans; returns before/after state; no grouped undo.

set_track_gain.description: Set route gain in dB (-193..+6), ignoring group linkage.

set_track_pan.description: Set stereo azimuth in signed normalized units -1..+1.

pan.description: Signed normalized azimuth: -1 left, 0 center, +1 right; stereo azimuth only
pan.title: Pan

arm_track.description: Set recording arm on a recordable track.

get_meter_state.description: Read route peak meter values in dBFS; no audio analysis in realtime.

get_transport.description: Read playhead in samples, speed, loop and recording state.

play.description: Request playback. Inspect get_transport to confirm asynchronous state.

locate.description: Locate using typed samples, seconds, quarter ticks or BBT.

start_recording.description: Enable session recording and request roll; arm tracks first.

stop_recording.description: Stop transport and disable session recording.

set_loop.description: Update an existing Ardour loop location and enable loop.

convert_position.description: Convert a typed position using Ardour's current tempo/meter map.

set_tempo.description: Insert constant quarter-note BPM point at a typed position.

bpm.description: Quarter notes per minute; constant tempo point
bpm.title: Bpm

set_time_signature.description: Insert a time signature point through TempoMap.

list_regions.description: Paginate active-playlist regions by route ID and kind.

get_region.description: Read region ID, playlist, source offset, timeline position and length.

create_midi_region.description: Create a blank internal MIDI region in Editor context.

move_region.description: Move a region nondestructively; named native undo.

copy_region.description: Copy to a compatible active playlist; fork MIDI source independently; audio shares source; native playlist undo.

trim_region.description: Trim to absolute timeline bounds within original region; native undo.

split_region.description: Split inside a region using its owning playlist; native undo.

delete_region.description: Remove a region from active playlist with native undo and explicit delete intent.

set_region_gain.description: Set audio-region amplitude in dB nondestructively.

set_region_mute.description: Set region mute with native undo.

set_region_lock.description: Set region lock state with native undo.

set_region_fades.description: Set audio fade durations in samples; preserve current fade shapes.

list_midi_notes.description: Paginate internal notes with source-relative 1920-quarter ticks and guarded model references.

insert_midi_notes.description: Insert up to 10000 exact internal notes in one native note-diff undo command.

start_ticks.description: Source-relative quarter-note ticks; 1920 ticks per quarter; get region source offset before editing trimmed regions
start_ticks.title: Start Ticks

edit_midi_notes.description: Replace guarded notes atomically in one native diff; pitch/time/length/velocity/channel.

start_ticks.description: Source-relative quarter-note ticks; 1920 ticks per quarter; get region source offset before editing trimmed regions
start_ticks.title: Start Ticks

delete_midi_notes.description: Remove guarded notes in one diff; model fingerprint and explicit delete intent required.

list_available_plugins.description: Query Ardour inventory; filter names/categories; formats are runtime dependent.

list_track_plugins.description: Paginate plugin instances with stable processor IDs.

add_plugin.description: Load inventory-selected plugin ID/format and insert at processor index.

remove_plugin.description: Remove plugin processor with explicit intent; not natively undoable.

get_plugin_parameters.description: Inspect parameter ordinal/port ID, native value, range/default and available display metadata.

set_plugin_parameters.description: Validate and set a batch of native parameter values; rollback supported values on failure.

parameter_index.description: Ardour nth_parameter ordinal, not plugin port ID
parameter_index.title: Parameter Index

value.description: Native plugin value; not normalized; use inspected metadata
value.title: Value

unit.description: Must match reported unit; plugin_native when physical unit is unavailable
unit.title: Unit

load_plugin_preset.description: Load an existing plugin preset by exact label.

list_sends.description: List sends with stable processor and target route IDs.

create_send.description: Create an internal aux send to a bus; reject routing feedback cycles.

remove_send.description: Remove send with explicit delete intent.

list_ports.description: Paginate engine port names and connections; port IDs are backend-qualified names.

connect_ports.description: Connect valid output to input with matching data type.

disconnect_ports.description: Disconnect one exact existing port connection.

get_automation.description: Inspect automation points and mode for gain, pan, plugin or send.

create_automation_points.description: Batch exact points with explicit native units; replace requires delete intent; native memento undo.

value.description: Native control units: gain/send linear coefficient, pan 0..1, plugin_native
value.title: Value

clear_automation.description: Clear target automation with explicit delete intent and native undo.

undo.description: Invoke Editor native undo once; only native undoable edits are guaranteed.

execute_batch.description: Prevalidate compensable control edits and apply with rollback; no general ACID promise.

render_range.description: Export master range using actual Ardour preset into a new isolated directory.

output_directory.description: New empty directory under an explicitly allowed export root
output_directory.title: Output Directory

preset_id.description: Existing Ardour export preset UUID; empty uses SimpleExport default; format defined by preset
preset_id.title: Preset Id

analyze_audio_file.description: Offline peak/RMS/LUFS/spectrum/stereo/silence and estimated true peak; allowed roots only.

compare_audio_files.description: Compare two measured passes; no subjective quality score.

ensure_bus.description: Ensure one exact-name/channel-count audio bus exists; refuse ambiguous collisions; return creation changes and stable ID.

render_and_analyze.description: Render one preset-based master file, then analyze locally; preserve export and report stage/error if analysis fails; no atomic file rollback.

output_directory.description: New empty directory under an explicitly allowed export root
output_directory.title: Output Directory

preset_id.description: Existing Ardour export preset UUID; empty uses SimpleExport default; format defined by preset
preset_id.title: Preset Id
